description: This Python script named 'sercomm-crypto.py' generates a header and cryptographic key based on input file properties and writes it to an output file, also saving the key in hexadecimal form. It appears to be part of a custom encryption or packaging process, likely related to device or firmware security.

methods.name: create_header(key, version, iv, random, size)
methods.description: Creates a fixed-size header containing key, version, IV, random, and size information, packed into a binary structure.

methods.name: create_output(args)
